knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r preamble}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(enrichR)
library(scales)

save_path <- "../../results/satmut_promoters_analysis/satmut_promoter_enrichr_gene_sets/"
dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# gene list input path (from overall_promoter notebook)
genelist_path <- "../../results/satmut_promoters_analysis/satmut_promoters_overall_promoters/"

websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")

if (websiteLive) {
    listEnrichrSites()
    setEnrichrSite("Enrichr") # Human genes
}

if (websiteLive) {
    dbs <- listEnrichrDbs()
    sort(dbs$libraryName)
}

top_ordered_genes_both <- as.vector(fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_both.txt"), header = F)$V1)
top_ordered_genes_neg <- as.vector(fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_neg.txt"), header = F)$V1)
top_ordered_genes_pos <- as.vector(fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_pos.txt"), header = F)$V1)
top_ordered_genes_nonsig <- as.vector(fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_nonsig.txt"), header = F)$V1)
top_ordered_genes_background <- as.vector(fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_background.txt"), header = F)$V1)
```

```{r enrichment}
dbs <- c(
  "GO_Biological_Process_2025", 
  "Reactome_Pathways_2024", 
  "MGI_Mammalian_Phenotype_Level_4_2024"
)

enriched <- list()
if (websiteLive) {
    enriched[["neg"]] <- enrichr(top_ordered_genes_neg, dbs, background = top_ordered_genes_background)
    enriched[["pos"]] <- enrichr(top_ordered_genes_pos, dbs, background = top_ordered_genes_background)
    enriched[["both"]] <- enrichr(top_ordered_genes_both, dbs, background = top_ordered_genes_background)
}

enriched <- map(enriched, function(x) {map(x, as_tibble)})
```

```{r visualize}
# Clean up term labels
clean_term <- function(term) {
  str_remove(term, "\\s*\\(GO:\\d+\\)$") %>%
    str_remove("\\s*R-HSA-\\d+$") %>%
    str_remove("\\s*WP\\d+$") %>%
    str_wrap(width = 50)
}

# Pretty database names for plot titles
db_labels <- c(
  "GO_Biological_Process_2025" = "GO Biological Process 2025",
  "Reactome_Pathways_2024"     = "Reactome Pathways 2024",
  "MGI_Mammalian_Phenotype_Level_4_2024" = "MGI Mammalian Phenotype Level 4 2024"
)

set_labels <- c(neg = "Negative ρ genes", pos = "Positive ρ genes", both = "Both (negative and positive) ρ genes")

n_top <- 20

for (set_name in names(enriched)) {
  sig_all <- list()
  for (db in names(enriched[[set_name]])) {
    df <- enriched[[set_name]][[db]]
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) next
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        log10p = -log10(P.value),
        Significance = case_when(
          Adjusted.P.value < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
          Adjusted.P.value < 0.10 ~ "FDR < 0.10",
          TRUE                    ~ "FDR ≥ 0.10"
        ),
        Significance = factor(Significance,
                              levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR < 0.10", "FDR ≥ 0.10")),
        Term_clean = clean_term(Term)
      ) %>%
      arrange(P.value)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) next

    n_sig   <- sum(df$Significance == "FDR < 0.05")
    n_suggestive <- sum(df$Significance == "FDR < 0.10")
    df <- df %>%
      slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
      mutate(Term_clean = fct_reorder(Term_clean, log10p))
    subtitle_text <- if (n_sig > 0 || n_suggestive > 0) {
      parts <- c()
      if (n_sig > 0)
        parts <- c(parts, paste0(n_sig, " with FDR < 0.05"))
      if (n_suggestive > 0)
        parts <- c(parts, paste0(n_suggestive, " with FDR < 0.10"))
      paste(parts, collapse = "; ")
    } else {
      "No terms with FDR < 0.10"
    }

    sig_colors <- c(both = "#984ea3", neg = "#fc8d62", pos = "#8da0cb")
    mid_colors <- c(both = "#c9a5d6", neg = "#fdc6a1", pos = "#c6d0e5")
    fill_values <- c(
      "FDR < 0.05" = sig_colors[[set_name]],
      "FDR < 0.10" = mid_colors[[set_name]],
      "FDR ≥ 0.10" = "#e3e1ef"
    )
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log10p, y = Term_clean, fill = Significance)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = fill_values,
        name = NULL,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      labs(
        x = expression(-log[10] ~ italic(P)),
        y = NULL,
        title = paste0(db_labels[db] %||% db),
        subtitle = paste0(set_labels[set_name], " — ", subtitle_text)
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey40"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.85),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 14, 6, 6)
      )

    fig_h <- max(5, 0.4 * nrow(df) + 2.5) / 1.5
    fig_w <- 7 / 1.5

    # save table
    db_short <- str_replace_all(db, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") %>% str_to_lower()
    write_tsv(enriched[[set_name]][[db]], paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_enrichr_table_", set_name, "_", db_short, ".txt"))

    # collect significant terms
    sig_terms <- enriched[[set_name]][[db]] %>%
      filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.10) %>%
      mutate(
        Database = db_labels[db] %||% db,
        Significance = ifelse(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05, "FDR < 0.05", "FDR < 0.10")
      )
    if (nrow(sig_terms) > 0) sig_all[[db]] <- sig_terms

    # save plot
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_enrichr_barplot_", set_name, "_", db_short, ".pdf"),
      plot = p, width = fig_w, height = fig_h, device = cairo_pdf
    )

    cat("\n\n###", set_labels[set_name], "—", db_labels[db] %||% db, "\n\n")
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  # save combined significant results
  sig_combined <- bind_rows(sig_all)
  if (nrow(sig_combined) > 0) {
    sig_combined <- sig_combined %>% arrange(Adjusted.P.value, Database)
    write_tsv(sig_combined, paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_enrichr_significant_", set_name, ".txt"))
  }
}
```

```{r main_figure}
# Collect all significant terms (FDR < 0.10) across sets and databases
sig_rows <- list()
for (set_name in names(enriched)) {
  for (db in names(enriched[[set_name]])) {
    df <- enriched[[set_name]][[db]]
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) next
    hits <- df %>%
      filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.10) %>%
      mutate(
        Set = set_name,
        Database = db_labels[db] %||% db,
        Term_clean = clean_term(Term)
      )
    if (nrow(hits) > 0) sig_rows[[paste(set_name, db)]] <- hits
  }
}
sig_df <- bind_rows(sig_rows)
if (nrow(sig_df) > 0) {
  sig_colors <- c(both = "#984ea3", neg = "#fc8d62", pos = "#8da0cb")
  db_abbrev <- c(
    "GO Biological Process 2025" = "GO",
    "Reactome Pathways 2024"     = "RP",
    "MGI Mammalian Phenotype Level 4 2024" = "MGI"
  )
  sig_df <- sig_df %>%
    mutate(
      log10p = -log10(P.value),
      Set = factor(Set, levels = c("neg", "pos", "both")),
      # strip MP/GO/R-HSA/WP codes
      Term_short = str_remove(Term, "\\s*\\(GO:\\d+\\)$") %>%
        str_remove("\\s*R-HSA-\\d+$") %>%
        str_remove("\\s*WP\\d+$") %>%
        str_remove("\\s*MP:\\d+$"),
      Term_short = str_trim(Term_short),
      db_short = db_abbrev[Database]
    ) %>%
    group_by(Set) %>%
    {
      bind_rows(
        filter(., Set == "neg") %>% slice_min(P.value, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE),
        filter(., Set == "both"),
        filter(., Set == "pos")
      )
    } %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      set_order = case_when(Set == "neg" ~ 3L, Set == "both" ~ 2L, Set == "pos" ~ 1L),
      row_label = paste0(Term_short, " [", db_short, "]"),
      row_label = fct_reorder2(row_label, set_order, -log10p)
    )
  p_main <- ggplot(sig_df, aes(x = log10p, y = row_label, fill = Set)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = row_label),
      hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.3, size = 3.5, colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_colors,
      labels = set_labels,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.5))) +
    labs(
      x = expression(-log[10] ~ italic(P)),
      y = NULL,
      title = "Enriched gene sets",
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey50", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 14, 6, 6)
    )
  fig_size <- 7
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_enrichr_main_figure.pdf"),
    plot = p_main, width = fig_size, height = fig_size, device = cairo_pdf
  )
  print(p_main)
} else {
  cat("No terms with FDR < 0.10 found across any analysis.\n")
}
```
